author: James Strange (StrangeFawkes)
description: Cashback routing for AI agents. Agents route purchases through a member's tracked link; the human completes checkout and earns 70% of the affiliate commission. 137 live programs across Awin and CJ Affiliate.
name: Dark Money

tools.description: List the stores where Dark Money members currently earn cashback, with the commission and the member's 70% share at each. Call this to see where a purchase can earn cashback before routing it. Dark Money is location-specific: pass the member's country to list only the stores usable there.

country.description: Optional ISO country code for the member's location, e.g. 'US', 'GB', 'RO'. When given, only programs a member in that country can use are listed (global programs always match).

tools.name: list_programs
tools.title: List cashback programs

tools.description: Get a Dark Money member's tracked cashback link for a store. Give the member this link (or open it for them): the purchase must go through it for the cashback to be credited to their balance. The human completes checkout — never purchase on the member's behalf. Requires the member's Dark Money member ID (format dm_XXXXXXXXXX). If the human is not a member yet, use join_dark_money first (with their consent).

member_id.description: The member's Dark Money ID, e.g. dm_Am5HeABD5C.

tools.name: get_cashback_link
tools.title: Get a member's tracked cashback link

tools.description: Create a free Dark Money membership for a human and return their member ID. ONLY call this with the human's explicit consent, using their own name and email, and only after they have agreed to the Terms (https://darkmoney.strangefawkes.com/terms.html) — setting terms_agreed=true asserts that agreement. Membership is free and activates instantly. The member earns 70% of commissions on purchases routed through their tracked links; payouts at $20.

payout.description: Preferred payout method; 'later' is fine — it can be set any time before the first payout.

terms_agreed.description: Must be true, and only when the human has actually agreed to the Dark Money Terms.

tools.name: join_dark_money
tools.title: Create a free Dark Money membership
